style: Zero Facility / grounded contemporary military industrial

concrete.prompt: Photorealistic physically based material base color texture for a contemporary military tactical FPS set in a decommissioned industrial research facility. Restrained realistic art direction, cool neutral grays, muted desaturated colors, credible manufacturing and use. Orthographic straight-on surface scan, completely flat even cross-polarized diffuse lighting. No baked highlights, no directional light or cast shadows, no perspective, no scene, no objects in front of the surface, no typography, no watermark, no border. Edge-to-edge material only. Fine and medium scale detail, restrained wear, no excessive destruction or rusty post-apocalyptic look. Seamless tileable pale warm gray cast concrete wall surface covering approximately 2 by 2 meters. Subtle cement mottling, limestone aggregate, tiny bugholes, faint formwork impressions and occasional fine hairline cracks. Clean enough for a maintained facility. Uniform density and scale. No panel joints, no large cracks, no stripes, no graffiti, no metal. Opposite edges must match seamlessly.
concrete.processing: Brightness normalization, restrained saturation, local edge matching for tileable maps; approximate high-frequency luminance micro-normal and conservative roughness, not measured PBR.
